payload.artist_html: S. Renesto, F. Saller, F. M. Dalla Vecchia
payload.credit_html: "'Simonettoia tilaventina, a new tanystropheid (Diapsida Archosauromorpha) from the Upper Triassic (Norian) of northeastern Italy"
payload.description_html: Simonettoia tilaventina, holotype, the cervical vertebrae and the cervical-dorsal transition. Abbreviations: cr, ribs of the cervicals 4-6; cr8-9, the "plowshare-like" ribs of the cervicals 8-9; cv3-9, cervical vertebrae 3-9; dr, dorsal rib; dv1-4, dorsal vertebrae 1-4; and h, humerus.
